params.Title: Welcome to the ''Free Realms'' Wiki!
params.content: Here we encourage players to share information and knowledge about ''Free Realms'' that will help new players, or just any player, on just about anything you need to know about Free Realms! If you find something that you think is wrong, please correct it, or if you can't find it at all, please make a page for it. We hope you enjoy your browsing here and hope you have a great time contributing here if you choose to become a part of the Free Realms Wikia community!

params.content:

; Not sure where to start?
* Find out more about the wiki on the '''[[Project:About|About]]''' page.
* If you are new to wikis, check out the '''[[Wikia:Help:Tutorial 1|tutorial]]'''. 
* Check out '''[[w:c:help:Help:Starting this wiki|Help:Starting this wiki]]''' if you're setting up the wiki.

; Adding content
* Every wiki has two list of articles that need help called  '''[[:Category:Article stubs|"Stubs"]]''' and '''[[Special:Wantedpages|"Wanted Articles"]]'''. Don't be shy, get in there. 
* Uploading [[:Category:Images|images]] is another really easy way to help out - see the '''[[Special:Upload]]''' page!
* You can find a list of useful templates on [[:Category:Templates]], some of which are documented on the '''[[Project:Templates|templates project page]]'''.

; Talk and more...
* Check out the '''[[Project:Community Portal|community portal]]''' to see what the community is working on, to give feedback or just to say hi.

{{Quote|Mos Eisley Spaceport. You will never find a more wretched hive of scum and villainy, we must be cautious.|[[w:c:starwars:Obi-Wan_Kenobi|Ben Kenobi]]}}



Hello, I am known as Wuher MosEisley. My username was created while choosing a handle in [[w:c:gaming:Sony Online Entertainment|Sony Online Entertainment]]'s [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massively_multiplayer_online_game MMO] ''[[w:c:clonewarsadventures:Clone Wars Adventures|Clone Wars Adventures]]'', and later ''[[w:c:freerealms:Free Realms|Free Realms]]''. The name was derived from the book ''[[w:c:starwars:Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina|Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'', specifically the [[w:c:starwars:Mos Eisley Cantina|Mos Eisley Cantina]] and the character [[w:c:starwars:Wuher|Wuher]] from the ''[[w:c:starwars:Star Wars|Star Wars]]'' universe. I began actively playing ''CWA'' in November 2010 and ''FR'' in November 2011. I was named [https://archive.today/u5RI SOE gamer of the Month November 2011].

In June 2011, I started to actively contribute over Wikia on the [http://CloneWarsAdventures.Wikia.com Clone Wars Adventures Wikia]. In September 2011, I created a wikia focusing on the ''Clone Wars Adventures'' community, the [http://CloneWarsAdventuresCharacter.Wikia.com Clone Wars Adventures Character Wikia]. In March 2012, I adopted the [[w:c:freerealms:FreeRealms_Wiki|FreeRealms wikia]]. In March 2013, the FreeRealms wikia became the [https://archive.today/2TF4q Official wiki] site of ''Free Realms''. On 31 March 2014, ''Free Realms'' and ''Clone Wars Adventures'' both shut down. In September of 2018 I adopted the [http://CloneWarsAdventures.Wikia.com Clone Wars Adventures Wikia].
